A little time with God. Wisdom to carry into your day.

Women of Color Daily Devotional — Fall: Harvest Season is the physical devotional book featured in our FIND HER collection as Fall #2. Make room to read, reflect and return to your faith through the season.

Make it part of your day

  • Keep a copy nearby for your personal devotional time.
  • Give a book to a woman you want to encourage.
  • Pair it with Women of the Bible for Women of Color in a FIND HER set.

Format: Physical book.

Explore the Purple Set: two books and a tote, or choose the Full Purple Set with a bottle.
